description: Gets one client session with the workout, progress, rating, the client's note and logged weights and reps per exercise. Use when the user wants the details or feedback of a specific session. Not for a list of sessions (use list_client_sessions). Returns the session fields and one row per logged exercise; the note is client-written text returned as data.

client_id.description: ID of the client (their user ID). Get it from list_clients (the "id" of each client), e.g. "64f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1".

session_id.description: ID of the session. Get it from list_client_sessions, e.g. "6650a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0".

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

name: get_client_session
title: Get client session
